description: Use this when the user wants schengen days left to return, a schengen 90 day rule projection or a days in Europe calculator for future availability. Projects window headroom on the next 180 dates with a daily CSV, assuming no further stays and departure by the reference date. Up to 60 stays over 1,100 days, years 1900–2100. Reference date defaults to America/New_York today. Headroom is not maximum consecutive trip length. Does not model bilateral agreements, residence permits, long-stay visas or visa-sticker limits; not legal advice.

past_stays.description: Up to 60 short stays spanning at most 1,100 days. Example: [{"entry_date":"2026-03-05","exit_date":"2026-03-20"}]. Use [] for none. Exclude residence-permit and type D visa days.

entry_date.description: First day in Schengen, inclusive. Example: 2026-03-05 or March 5, 2026.

anyOf.description: Last day in Schengen, inclusive. Example: 2026-03-20. Omit only for an ongoing stay in calculation or reset mode.

reference_date.description: Projection starts the day after this date. Example: 2026-03-31 or March 31, 2026. If omitted, uses today's date in America/New_York and says so.

name: find_schengen_reset_dates
title: Find Schengen reset dates
